name: Track Memory
description: Remembers chosen audio and subtitle tracks per title across sessions and rewatches.
overview: Automatically persists and applies your preferred audio and subtitle selections for movies and episodes, including in-playback changes and details page pre-selections.

versions.changelog:
- Series-level track memory inheritance: remember audio and subtitle languages across TV series episodes
- Fix lifecycle by implementing IHostedService on PlaybackTrackerService
- Fix JSON parsing for string-encoded stream indices from Smart TV (webOS) clients
- Added language synonym matching (ISO-639 equivalents)

- Automatically remembers audio and subtitle track selections per title across sessions and rewatches
- Intercepts pre-playback track selections from details page
- In-playback dynamic stream change recording via ISessionManager events
- Transparent server-side DefaultAudioStreamIndex and DefaultSubtitleStreamIndex injection into PlaybackInfo responses
- Support for compressed payloads (gzip, brotli, deflate) on Smart TV (webOS) clients
